issues.evidence: "No random oracle, PKI or other setup. Mining is not modelled by an oracle or by probabilities". resources/notes.md lines 3-36 say nothing about setup, PKI or how mining is modelled beyond notes:25. The sentence resolves a point on which the notes are silent, has no notes:N source and no Source map row, and is not listed under "Open points". Acceptance criterion 2 of the brief asks that silent points be listed, not resolved. It does not change any A-ID, so it is not model drift, but a later proof could cite it as if it were part of the model.
